sections.title: Meeting Place and Dates
sections.content:
Stanford was selected as the site of the second Network Graphics meeting. Sessions were to take place in the Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory conference room, with the Flamingo Motel in Palo Alto about two miles away.

The conference was scheduled to begin at 6:00 PM Pacific time on November 21 and end at noon on November 23.
sections.plainLanguage: The meeting was scheduled at Stanford's AI Laboratory from the evening of November 21 until noon on November 23. Attendees were directed to a motel in Palo Alto.

sections.title: Lodging and Banquet
sections.content: The Flamingo Motel rate was $8.25 per night. A Chinese banquet was planned for Monday, November 22, at the Golden Pavillion restaurant in Los Altos for $7.20 per plate. Attendees could invite guests who were not part of the network.
sections.plainLanguage: Rooms were listed at $8.25 per night, and the planned banquet cost $7.20 per person. Attendees could invite non-network guests to dinner.

sections.title: Registration Information
sections.content:
Attendees were asked to provide their name and site, say whether they needed a room or would attend the banquet, indicate whether they would rent a car for a transportation pool, and describe any planned talk and audio-visual needs.

The latest withdrawal date for room and banquet reservations was November 18. The notice says reservations would be considered binding after that date.
sections.plainLanguage: Attendees were asked to tell Stanford what they needed and whether they planned to give a talk. Room and banquet plans had to be changed by November 18.
